quarterly_data.signal: SpaceX's IPO prospectus customer concentration: one significant customer (Customer A, not named) accounted for 20.9% of consolidated revenue in 2025, 24.2% in 2024 and 25.2% in 2023; revenue from this customer relates to all three segments (Space, Connectivity and AI), and no other customer represented more than 10% of consolidated revenue in those years. The prospectus also notes that its direct chip suppliers depend on a concentrated group of advanced semiconductor fabrication facilities.

SpaceX's IPO prospectus AI segment data: AI segment revenue of $3,201 million in 2025 versus $2,620 million in 2024, including AI Solutions & Infrastructure revenue of $1,357 million versus $892 million; AI segment revenue of $818 million in Q1 2026 versus $727 million in Q1 2025 (AI Solutions & Infrastructure $284 million in Q1 2025). AI segment capital expenditures were $12,727 million in 2025 versus $5,633 million in 2024 and $463 million in 2023, and $7,723 million in Q1 2026 versus $2,567 million in Q1 2025; total capital expenditures were $20,737 million in 2025 and $10,107 million in Q1 2026. The AI key-metric table shows nameplate compute draw of 0.8 gigawatts for 2025 and 0.3 for 2024. Total revenue was $18,674 million in 2025 versus $14,015 million in 2024.
